observations.action: Troque o código por token usando o verificador PKCE e a redirect URI vinculada. Antes da troca válida, tente os dois valores errados; depois tente reutilizar o código.
observations.guarantee: The local authorization-code model binds verifier and redirect, permits one code redemption and issues an audience/scope-limited signed access token.
observations.limit: A teaching model of RFC 6749/7636 message checks; it is not an authorization-server library, browser login, refresh flow or production OAuth security implementation.

observations.action: Valide o ID token assinado e repita com nonce diferente, audience diferente e assinatura alterada. Confira que conhecer um sub no JSON não basta para aceitar a identidade.
observations.guarantee: The ID-token validation property checks issuer, audience, nonce, expiration and the configured HS256 signature before accepting the subject.
observations.limit: The synthetic client uses a preconfigured shared key. Discovery, JWKS, key negotiation, all claim rules and an actual OpenID Provider are not implemented.

observations.action: Emita tokens com old e new, aceite ambos na janela de sobreposição e retire old do verificador. Confira a validação criptográfica, a recusa do token antigo e a recusa da assinatura alterada.
observations.guarantee: A signed credential remains valid through the overlap and becomes inadmissible after its signing key is removed from trust.
observations.limit: Keys are fixed synthetic HMAC material. Secret storage, asymmetric key distribution and coordinated live-service rotation are outside the experiment.

observations.action: Autentique o cliente de serviço antes de emitir a credencial e valide sua assinatura no recurso. Compare com aceitar um nome de serviço apenas declarado pelo chamador.
observations.guarantee: The resource authenticates a signed service principal and validates its intended audience/scope rather than trusting a caller-supplied service label.
observations.limit: Client secrets and tokens are synthetic; there is no real identity provider, protected key store or live service deployment.

observations.action: Valide o token destinado ao gateway e troque-o por uma credencial mais curta para order-api. Confira o usuário preservado, o ator do serviço e a redução de escopo.
observations.guarantee: The exchanged credential is bound to the target resource and a narrower delegated scope, preserving subject and actor identities.
observations.limit: This is an RFC 8693-style claim transformation model, without a token-exchange endpoint or a complete delegation authorization policy.

observations.action: Marque os dois pedidos como internos. Recuse o serviço rogue mesmo com token assinado válido e aceite somente o principal e a permissão esperados para o recurso.
observations.guarantee: Network location does not replace per-request identity and resource-policy verification in the tested boundary.
observations.limit: This demonstrates one zero-trust access property, not an organization-wide zero-trust architecture, device posture or continuous risk engine.

observations.action: Tente o acesso administrativo direto e depois os dois saltos permitidos via bastion. Repita o primeiro salto com uma pessoa sem papel administrativo.
observations.guarantee: Administrative access is funneled through an authenticated jump boundary and direct access to the protected target is denied.
observations.limit: The graph executes authorization and routing decisions, not SSH, a real bastion host, firewall rules or session recording.

observations.action: Execute três handshakes TLS por socketpair: servidor sem exigir cliente, servidor exigindo cliente ausente e cliente com certificado confiável. Confira a autenticação dos dois pares e a troca de ORDER-1.
observations.guarantee: Real SSLContext handshakes reject a client missing its certificate when mutual verification is required and authenticate both trusted peers before exchanging data.
observations.limit: Certificates and keys are generated only in a temporary directory and removed. No listening port, external connection, production CA or service configuration is changed.

observations.action: Faça dois workers lógicos consultarem a mesma posição pelo dono da chave no cache compartilhado. Confira que a segunda leitura não volta à fonte.
observations.guarantee: Different logical workers use the same partition owner and share its populated cache entry, unlike independent per-worker caches.
observations.limit: The owners are local dictionaries; the experiment isolates shared-owner cache semantics without claiming a networked cache product or cross-machine durability.

observations.action: Prepare a rodada 8 em dois acceptors que já aceitaram ORDER-A na rodada 7. Proponha ORDER-B e confira por que o novo proposer precisa carregar o valor previamente aceito.
observations.guarantee: A prepare quorum reports accepted values; the proposer carries the value at the highest accepted ballot rather than inventing a different value.
observations.limit: A finite single-decree Paxos schedule with reliable local messages; persistence, liveness and arbitrary faults are not implemented.

observations.action: Envie AppendEntries com prevLogIndex=2 e prevLogTerm=3 para uma réplica cujo termo no índice 2 é 2. Confira a recusa e a repetição a partir do prefixo comum.
observations.guarantee: The follower checks the previous index/term before appending; a retry from a matching prefix replaces conflicting suffix entries.
observations.limit: This isolates Raft log matching, without election, durable storage, commitment or a complete replicated state machine.

observations.action: Faça B votar em A no termo 2 e depois receber C no mesmo termo. Confira que B não vota nos dois candidatos e que só A reúne a maioria.
observations.guarantee: A voter remembers its vote in the term and refuses a second different candidate in that term.
observations.limit: The fixture does not implement log freshness, randomized timeouts, persistence or all election transitions.

observations.action: Faça os dois participantes reconhecerem canCommit e preCommit. Compare a decisão no modelo síncrono declarado com o caso em que uma partição ainda é possível.
observations.guarantee: The extra precommit state distinguishes the modeled 3PC decision from an uncertain 2PC prepare, under the explicit timing and no-partition assumptions.
observations.limit: This is not a partition-tolerant atomic commit implementation; the autonomous commit decision is not generalized outside those assumptions.

observations.action: Receba o evento 1010:3 com relógio físico em 1005 e relógio local em 1006:1. Confira a parte física máxima e o contador lógico que conserva a ordem causal.
observations.guarantee: The receive rule combines the physical maximum with a logical counter when the received wall component wins.
observations.limit: The one receive schedule does not synchronize physical clocks or prove a distributed implementation under every skew pattern.

observations.action: Mantenha a réplica na versão 1 enquanto o primário está na 2. Confira que a confirmação sincronizada espera a aplicação e que a leitura dessa réplica após a confirmação vê a versão 2.
observations.guarantee: The writer acknowledgement is ordered after this replica applies the write, providing the tested after-ack visibility property.
observations.limit: This bounded primary/replica schedule does not alone prove linearizability, all replica routing or consistency under partitions.

observations.action: Aplique a versão de A em B e só depois replique B em C. Observe que C depende do intermediário, em vez de consultar diretamente A.
observations.guarantee: Replication follows A to B to C, exposing the intermediate replica as the source of the final replica.
observations.limit: The model has one ordered update, no WAL streams, failover or network delay.

observations.action: Aceite um crédito distinto em A e B. Compare a última substituição absoluta de saldo com a reconciliação das identidades dos dois créditos.
observations.guarantee: Both sites accept writes and reconciliation preserves distinct additive credits instead of choosing one absolute snapshot.
observations.limit: This merge is valid only for the declared independent credits; noncommutative debits and invariants need a business conflict policy.

observations.action: Leia 1.000, conclua o crédito de 100 no dono serializado e faça outra leitura sem carregar um token de sessão. Confira a versão e a ordem das operações no histórico.
observations.guarantee: Every read in this single-owner schedule observes the latest preceding completed write, independently of a client session hint.
observations.limit: This is one serialized-owner history, not a universal linearizability proof or a distributed strong-consistency system under failures.

observations.action: Recupere a mesma versão com uma cópia fria, uma morna e uma quente. Execute os passos que faltam em cada uma antes de promover seu papel para primário.
observations.guarantee: Standby readiness changes the restore/start/catch-up work required before the role transition.
observations.limit: The steps are state transitions in a finite model, not measured RTO, restored backups or real database promotion.

observations.action: Avance o relógio de 0 para 6 com prazo 5, detecte o heartbeat antigo e promova a cópia que já alcançou a versão necessária.
observations.guarantee: A failure detector based on heartbeat age triggers the modeled role transition automatically.
observations.limit: A timeout suspects failure; this local model does not prove the old primary stopped or supply fencing under a network partition.

observations.action: Distribua as duas instâncias entre zonas e regiões distintas e remova uma zona ou região inteira. Compare as instâncias que sobrevivem aos mesmos domínios de falha.
observations.guarantee: Replica placement across different failure domains leaves one instance after the declared zone or region outage.
observations.limit: Replication freshness, routing, shared dependencies, quorum and regulatory placement are not inferred from the survivor count.

observations.action: Mantenha o processo saudável enquanto as duas vagas estão ocupadas e três pedidos aguardam. Calcule tráfego, duração, erros, utilização e saturação em seus grãos declarados.
observations.guarantee: The sample distinguishes healthy process status from traffic/latency/errors/saturation and from resource utilization/saturation/errors.
observations.limit: These are controlled sample measurements, not production percentiles, SLOs or a capacity benchmark.

observations.action: Execute o SDK OpenTelemetry fixado, injete e extraia traceparent entre gateway e provider e exporte para memória. Confira o mesmo trace, o parent span e o erro, sem confundir dois spans com duas requisições.
observations.guarantee: The real SDK exports two parent/child spans in one trace, propagates context and records one failed span for one request.
observations.limit: The exporter is in memory with SDK 1.45.1. There is no collector, network service or claim of production instrumentation.

observations.action: Execute o crédito pelo controlador e confira que a apresentação recebe apenas os dados finais, sem realizar a escrita do modelo.
observations.guarantee: The controller changes the model and selects a view; the view renders a DTO and never owns the write.
observations.limit: A local role model; routing, templates and a web framework are not implemented.

observations.action: Substitua a view por uma lista que recebe chamadas do presenter. Confira quem lê o modelo e quem transforma a informação para apresentação.
observations.guarantee: The presenter loads and prepares the model result; a passive view only receives the display value.
observations.limit: The recording view models the interface boundary rather than a full UI toolkit.

observations.action: Altere a propriedade balance do view model e observe o callback de binding atualizar a apresentação sem uma chamada explícita de renderização no comando.
observations.guarantee: A binding propagates an observable view-model property change into the view.
observations.limit: The model covers one-way binding; validation, two-way binding and UI lifecycle remain outside it.

observations.action: Faça dois controles filhos atualizarem suas abstrações e peça ao controle pai para compor o total. Compare com a última escrita isolada de uma apresentação compartilhada.
observations.guarantee: Each agent owns abstraction, presentation and control; parent control coordinates the child agents.
observations.limit: This is a small hierarchical PAC model, not a recommendation to adopt PAC in MakersHub.

observations.action: Siga presentation, application e domain e troque a implementação da porta de gravação entre dois adaptadores. Confira a regra e os imports do domínio.
observations.guarantee: Ordered invocation exhibits layers; the domain depends on its port and two replaceable adapters implement that port, exhibiting the inward dependency property of Clean/Onion/Hexagonal designs.
observations.limit: Only these boundary properties are modeled. The four styles have further distinctions not erased by sharing the exercise.

observations.action: Execute a ordem pelo contrato público do módulo e atualize posições pelo contrato do outro módulo. Examine o agrupamento da validação, do handler e da persistência na fatia de ordens.
observations.guarantee: Public component contracts separate modules in one process; the order feature groups the steps of one vertical use case.
observations.limit: The model demonstrates module and feature boundaries, not automatic proof of a repository-wide architecture.

observations.action: Registre um plugin premium no catálogo e execute a política pelo contrato já usado pelo núcleo. Confira que o dispatcher não ganha um novo condicional.
observations.guarantee: A stable kernel invokes a registered extension through a shared contract.
observations.limit: Isolation, signing, lifecycle and dependency policy of untrusted plugins are not implemented.

observations.action: Execute os especialistas na ordem em que alocação tenta agir antes de risco. Observe o quadro de fatos permitir que a próxima rodada conclua a alocação.
observations.guarantee: Independent specialists read and contribute to a shared problem state until their prerequisites become available.
observations.limit: The fixture has monotonic facts and two rounds; conflict resolution and an unrestricted expert scheduler are outside it.

observations.action: Envie dois incrementos ao ator e deixe somente seu consumidor de mailbox escrever o estado. Compare com dois leitores que gravam a partir do mesmo valor antigo.
observations.guarantee: A private state owner serializes messages and provides a single writer for this actor.
observations.limit: The mailbox is local; supervision, distributed actors and message durability are not claimed.

observations.action: Aceite o crédito no produtor e observe a projeção só avançar quando seu handler recebe o evento. Inspecione que o produtor não chama a projeção diretamente.
observations.guarantee: The producer emits a fact and a subscribed handler reacts to it asynchronously in the local schedule.
observations.limit: Transport, delivery guarantees and cross-process execution are not part of this event-driven property model.

observations.action: Execute o mesmo contrato de conta por duas operações e provoque uma falha no serviço vizinho. Confira que a leitura do dono da conta continua independente.
observations.guarantee: An explicit business service owns its store and operation contract; the other service failure does not mutate or prevent its operation in this controlled schedule.
observations.limit: Services are logical local participants. Network independence, deployment, discovery and distributed transactions are not proven.

observations.action: Inicie cada invocação com memória local nova e conserve o crédito pela porta externa. Confira que a segunda invocação vê 1.100 sem depender de um processo aquecido.
observations.guarantee: The handler tolerates fresh invocation memory and keeps authoritative state outside that ephemeral environment.
observations.limit: No cloud runtime, billing, autoscaling or vendor-specific execution contract is simulated.

observations.action: Distribua as doze entradas pelo dono da chave e execute a alteração dentro de cada partição em memória. Confira a distribuição e a soma sem consultar um banco central.
observations.guarantee: A partitioned memory grid owns data and co-locates processing; the same owner partitions can serve shared cache reads to different logical workers.
observations.limit: The grid is a finite local model, without durable replication, network partitions or a deployed distributed-cache product.

observations.action: Provoque a falha da célula A e continue o pedido destinado à célula B. Confira que a recuperação não redireciona silenciosamente dados de A para B.
observations.guarantee: Independent cells contain one failure while the other cell completes its own request.
observations.limit: Capacity, routing safety, replication and failover between real regions remain outside this local failure-boundary experiment.

observations.action: Tente acrescentar 50 e 80 a uma cesta com limite 100. Compare a escrita direta dos filhos com a única entrada pública da raiz, que preserva o total válido.
observations.guarantee: The root owns the public mutation operation and checks the invariant spanning its children before accepting the next item.
observations.limit: The aggregate is in memory; Python private attributes are a convention and distributed transaction boundaries are not established.

observations.action: Transfira 100 entre duas entidades pelo serviço de domínio e confira a conservação do total, em vez de creditar o destino isoladamente.
observations.guarantee: A domain operation involving two entities preserves the stated transfer invariant without belonging naturally to either entity alone.
observations.limit: Only an in-memory operation is executed; durable atomic transfer, fees and real financial rules are not claimed.

observations.action: Troque o armazenamento entre dicionário e lista de linhas mantendo get/save e a entidade Account usados pela operação. Confira 1.100 nas duas implementações.
observations.guarantee: The repository presents a domain collection contract while storage representation changes behind it.
observations.limit: The adapters are local fakes, without SQL mapping, identity maps or unit-of-work concurrency.

observations.action: Envie um comando inválido ao serviço de aplicação. Siga carregamento, validação e rejeição e confira que ele não manda persistir uma operação recusada.
observations.guarantee: The application service coordinates the use case and calls domain behavior before persistence instead of embedding a write before validation.
observations.limit: The ordering model does not supply an ORM transaction, authentication or a production application layer.

observations.action: Construa a transferência pela fábrica e tente repetir com valor negativo. Confira que uma transferência inválida não chega a existir pelo contrato público.
observations.guarantee: A factory centralizes the valid construction of the domain object and rejects invalid combinations.
observations.limit: The construction rule belongs only to this hypothetical transfer fixture.

observations.action: Aplique a mesma specification na seleção e na validação das três contas fictícias. Confira que a conta inativa deixa de aparecer como candidata em apenas um caminho.
observations.guarantee: One named criterion is reused across selection and validation, eliminating the duplicated inconsistent predicate in this fixture.
observations.limit: The threshold is a synthetic teaching rule, not an advisor or customer eligibility rule from Faz.

observations.action: Altere o contrato do fornecedor de available para settled_balance e reserved_balance. Execute os dois consumidores, identifique os quebrados no mapa e adapte os significados de disponibilidade em cada contexto.
observations.guarantee: An actual schema change exposes affected consumers; bounded contexts give available different meanings, and the supplier/consumer agreement restores explicit contracts and a shared vocabulary within each context.
observations.limit: The context map and language belong to this hypothetical business exercise. They do not assert the canonical Faz glossary or a historical organizational decision.

observations.action: Adapte o consumidor para usar diretamente provider_state=AUTHORISED, sem criar tradução local. Compare essa escolha com o adaptador semântico do caso anterior.
observations.guarantee: The downstream deliberately adopts the upstream vocabulary and schema, including its coupling cost.
observations.limit: The exercise demonstrates the relationship choice, not a recommendation to accept every provider concept.

observations.action: Mude a política de taxa de um contexto e execute o outro. Compare o objeto compartilhado acidentalmente com contratos independentes sem integração.
observations.guarantee: Choosing separate ways prevents an unrelated context from inheriting the other context change through a shared mutable object.
observations.limit: Duplication has a maintenance cost; this fixture does not decide the real organizational boundary.

observations.action: Execute os dois consumidores com a mesma regra compartilhada e altere o arredondamento do kernel. Observe que ambos mudam e precisam do mesmo acordo de versão.
observations.guarantee: The shared kernel makes a small domain rule genuinely shared and exposes the joint impact of changing it.
observations.limit: The rounding is synthetic. Joint ownership and release coordination are required rather than inferred from a common helper.

observations.action: Altere o armazenamento interno para settled_cents e mantenha uma operação pública versionada para os dois clientes. Confira que a forma interna não vaza para o contrato público.
observations.guarantee: A stable public service contract supports multiple consumers while internal representation changes behind it.
observations.limit: Version governance, authentication and remote transport are not provided by this local contract exercise.

observations.action: Leia o recurso por GET, crie outro por POST e tente um método não atendido. Confira a ausência de escrita no GET e os códigos 200, 201 e 405.
observations.guarantee: Resource paths, method semantics and response status are explicit; GET does not become an operation that writes.
observations.limit: Requests are local dictionaries and function calls, without an HTTP server, caching intermediaries or complete REST constraints.

observations.action: Envie a operação reserve com seus parâmetros e correlacione a resposta com REQUEST-1. Diferencie esse contrato por operação da rota de recurso do exercício REST.
observations.guarantee: The dispatcher invokes an explicit operation and returns its result to the matching requester.
observations.limit: The finite request/reply dispatcher does not implement a remote transport, deadlines or an RPC framework.

observations.action: Tente uma chamada sem permissão e depois chamadas para ordens e posições. Confira que o gateway recusa antes do backend, escolhe a rota e preserva método, corpo e resposta no encaminhamento.
observations.guarantee: The entry point routes requests, offloads authentication checks and forwards the accepted method/payload to the selected backend.
observations.limit: This models gateway/proxy properties, not a deployed reverse proxy, token verification, TLS termination or every HTTP forwarding rule.

observations.action: Monte a mesma visão a partir de posição e ordens para web e mobile. Observe uma chamada do cliente e os formatos distintos preparados no servidor.
observations.guarantee: A server-side composition calls two owners and returns a client-specific view, reducing client round trips without pretending the backend calls disappear.
observations.limit: Partial failures, freshness and authorization of each constituent service need separate contracts.

observations.action: Passe a representação da entidade Account com sua chave aos dois subgraphs lógicos e componha balance e open_orders pelo mesmo identificador.
observations.guarantee: Entity-reference resolution joins fields owned by different subgraphs through the declared entity key instead of a display label.
observations.limit: This is the entity-key resolution property of federation. It does not include a GraphQL parser, supergraph schema, query planner or Apollo runtime.

observations.action: Mude a ordem de accepted para settled e deixe o cliente procurar a relação cancel na representação recebida. Confira que ele não inventa uma ação que o servidor deixou de oferecer.
observations.guarantee: The representation exposes state-dependent action links and the client follows an available relation rather than hardcoding every transition.
observations.limit: The exercise covers one affordance and not an entire hypermedia API or authorization policy.

observations.action: Consulte três vezes até a posição existir e compare com uma requisição que aguarda o evento de atualização antes de responder.
observations.guarantee: Polling issues repeated requests; long polling holds one request until the result becomes available.
observations.limit: The wait uses a local asyncio event, with no HTTP timeout, intermediary buffering or reconnect loop.

observations.action: Codifique e leia registros id/event/data, desconecte depois do id 1 e retome com esse cursor. Confira que somente o id 2 é entregue de novo ao cliente.
observations.guarantee: SSE event records carry IDs and data; a server can honor the last received ID when selecting the resumed stream.
observations.limit: The record parser is local. HTTP streaming, browser EventSource, retry timing and proxy behavior are not executed.

observations.action: Envie um frame de texto mascarado do cliente e um frame independente do servidor. Decodifique os dois sentidos sem criar uma nova consulta para a mensagem do servidor.
observations.guarantee: Two independent text-frame directions share the duplex model; client frames are masked and server frames are decoded without a new poll.
observations.limit: Only small unfragmented text frames are modeled, without the HTTP upgrade handshake, extensions, control frames or a production WebSocket implementation.

observations.action: Receba o callback assinado, repita a mesma entrega e altere a assinatura. Confira um único efeito e a recusa 401 da mensagem que não passa na verificação.
observations.guarantee: The provider pushes the event to a callback; signature verification precedes the receiver effect and the event identity suppresses a repeat.
observations.limit: All keys and payloads are synthetic. Timestamp replay windows, secret distribution, TLS and a live callback server are not implemented.

observations.action: Faça cada workload usar seu proxy de saída. Atualize a política nos dois proxies e confira identidade, versão e resposta sem alterar a operação de negócio.
observations.guarantee: A companion outbound proxy adds transport policy and identity; distributing the same policy to both companion proxies exhibits one mesh control/data-plane property.
observations.limit: The proxies are logical local companions, not separate pods or a deployed service mesh. mTLS has its own distinct experiment.

observations.action: Reserve dinheiro e unidade na fase Try. Siga uma cópia pela confirmação e outra pelo cancelamento; confira quais recursos ficam disponíveis em cada caminho.
observations.guarantee: Try holds resources; Confirm consumes the hold, while Cancel releases the same held resources.
observations.limit: The two local outcomes model one reservation contract; distributed recovery, timeout races and idempotent callbacks remain separate obligations.

observations.action: Perdida a confirmação, compare repetir sem deduplicação com fazer somente uma tentativa. Depois perca a própria entrega e observe que nenhuma tentativa adicional a recupera.
observations.guarantee: At most one attempt avoids repeat delivery in this fixture but can lose the operation entirely.
observations.limit: This is a sender-attempt model, not a broker delivery guarantee or proof of the external effect.

observations.action: Atualize a origem dentro de uma transação que faz rollback e depois numa que faz commit. Leia o feed capturado e aplique o valor no destino da migração.
observations.guarantee: A database trigger captures only the committed after-image visible to the feed reader, allowing a destination to catch up instead of relying on a second independent application write.
observations.limit: Trigger-based CDC in SQLite is not WAL decoding, Debezium or a cross-database atomic transaction; cutover still requires reconciliation.

observations.action: Grave a ordem e a outbox na mesma transação e acompanhe o capturador da outbox gerar EVENT-1 no feed com uma posição de retomada.
observations.guarantee: The transactional outbox is the captured table, and its committed insert becomes the CDC feed item.
observations.limit: The learning connector is a SQLite trigger plus feed query; transport, source-log offsets and recipient deduplication are not implemented.

observations.action: Entregue EVENT-1 e perca somente sua confirmação. Repita até receber a confirmação e conte as duas entregas da mesma identidade.
observations.guarantee: Retry after an ambiguous acknowledgement restores acknowledgement while admitting repeat delivery of the same event.
observations.limit: Only this bounded acknowledgement-loss schedule is modeled; an exactly-once effect still needs the recipient transaction or idempotency mechanism.

observations.action: Ocupe as duas vagas de cotações e tente executar uma ordem. Compare o pool global com os pools independentes de cotações e ordens.
observations.guarantee: A saturated dependency consumes only its own budget; the independent order pool retains capacity.
observations.limit: The actual semaphore admissions are local. Memory, CPU and cross-process resource isolation require additional budgets.

observations.action: Pare o serviço lógico e execute a supervisão. Confira que ela cria uma nova geração e que a leitura de saúde volta a responder.
observations.guarantee: The supervisor detects the failed local state and rearms it through a replacement generation.
observations.limit: It is a finite restart model, without a real container, crash loop budget or a guarantee that every restart repairs the underlying cause.

observations.action: Provoque o timeout da fonte atual. Confira que a consulta limitada usa o último valor conhecido, sinaliza que ele não é atual e desabilita operações que exigiriam a informação fresca.
observations.guarantee: The fallback preserves a deliberately reduced read function and labels the stale result instead of silently claiming full service.
observations.limit: The cached value is synthetic; the acceptable age and permitted actions need the actual product contract.

observations.action: Declare uma ordem e um efeito como estado esperado, injete a perda da primeira entrega e execute a recuperação com repetição. Confira a violação inicial e a recuperação sem débito duplicado.
observations.guarantee: A declared steady-state invariant is observed before/after an intentional fault and recovery experiment.
observations.limit: The fault is injected only in a controlled local model, not in a production system or distributed chaos platform.

observations.action: Consuma o offset 0, interrompa e retome somente depois do checkpoint. Confira offsets 1 e 2 e a posição 130, sem repetir o crédito inicial.
observations.guarantee: An ordered event log and an explicit consumer position let the consumer resume the remaining events.
observations.limit: The log is a local immutable fixture. Retention, partitioned offsets, broker transactions and durable checkpoint atomicity are separate concerns.

observations.action: Processe os três eventos como um lote completo e depois um por vez. Observe quando cada modelo produz uma posição e confira o mesmo total final.
observations.guarantee: Batch emits after the chosen finite input set completes; stream processing updates the result as each event arrives.
observations.limit: The finite input demonstrates emission semantics rather than an unbounded engine, watermark or event-time guarantee.

observations.action: Mapeie as ordens para pares de tipo e valor, agrupe pela chave e reduza cada grupo. Confira buy=150 e sell=20.
observations.guarantee: The map/group/reduce stages aggregate values per key instead of confusing all partial values with one total.
observations.limit: This is local grouping, not a distributed shuffle, combiner or fault-tolerant MapReduce runtime.

observations.action: Defina o cutoff no offset 1, mantenha o lote até esse ponto e a visão rápida somente depois dele. Compare a soma sobreposta incorreta com 80 + 50 = 130.
observations.guarantee: Batch and speed-layer views cover disjoint input positions before being merged, preventing double counting at their boundary.
observations.limit: The example models the Lambda view boundary, without two deployed engines, backfill orchestration or full event-time handling.

observations.action: Corrija a interpretação do débito e reexecute o mesmo processador sobre o log. Acrescente um evento e confira que a mesma lógica atende reconstrução e continuidade.
observations.guarantee: One retained event log and one processing path support replay and ongoing processing rather than a separate batch algorithm.
observations.limit: Retention, reprocessing isolation and operational cutover of a new stream version are not implemented.

observations.action: Publique order-placed e deixe cada participante reagir ao fato que conhece. Observe funds-reserved, allocation-failed e compensated recomporem o saldo sem um coordenador que chame todos os passos.
observations.guarantee: Local subscribers emit the next facts and a compensation handler reacts to the failure, exhibiting choreographed saga collaboration.
observations.limit: Delivery, duplicate events, distributed recovery and cycles are not solved by this in-memory choreography.

observations.action: Retorne ao chamador depois de emitir a intenção e provoque a falha do worker mais tarde. Diferencie a confirmação da chamada da conclusão do trabalho.
observations.guarantee: The caller does not await the later handler result, so its successful return does not prove eventual delivery or business completion.
observations.limit: The outgoing queue is not durable and no delivery guarantee is claimed.

observations.action: Reúna o fluxo de ordens e o de liquidações preservando a origem de cada mensagem. Confira três entradas e as duas contagens por fonte.
observations.guarantee: Multiple input streams converge into one correlated output without discarding source ownership.
observations.limit: The finite merge does not order independent clocks or wait for a distributed completeness barrier.

observations.action: Interrompa depois de persistir credited, feche a conexão e reabra o arquivo de progresso. Confira que a retomada executa a notificação e não repete o crédito já registrado.
observations.guarantee: A persisted workflow identity and phase drive recovery after process-state loss, skipping the completed local step.
observations.limit: The local effects and checkpoints share SQLite transactions. External activity retries, timers, worker leasing and a full durable-workflow framework are not implemented.

observations.action: Avance o relógio além da validade de A, deixe B adquirir a autorização e tente liberar a lease com a identidade antiga de A.
observations.guarantee: Expiry makes the abandoned authorization reclaimable, while owner comparison prevents an old owner from releasing the new lease.
observations.limit: The model uses a controlled clock; expiration is not destination fencing and does not stop an old external side effect.

observations.action: Use duas conexões independentes ao mesmo coordenador SQLite. Dispute a chave ORDER-1 e tente liberar a chave com o dono errado.
observations.guarantee: Both participants use one atomic unique-key arbiter instead of independent local locks; ownership is checked at release.
observations.limit: SQLite is local to this machine. The experiment proves shared-arbiter coordination, not a networked lease service under partitions.

observations.action: Mantenha BEGIN IMMEDIATE aberto no primeiro escritor. Confira a recusa imediata da segunda conexão, finalize a primeira e repita a segunda escrita.
observations.guarantee: The writer obtains exclusion before changing the record; the second writer cannot begin its write transaction until release.
observations.limit: This is SQLite database-writer exclusion, not PostgreSQL row locking or a recommendation to hold locks during network calls.

observations.action: Mantenha um leitor com o snapshot anterior, copie antes da escrita e altere a nova cópia. Confira que o leitor continua em 1.000 enquanto a cópia chega a 1.100.
observations.guarantee: A writer changes a new copy instead of mutating the snapshot held by the old reader.
observations.limit: The fixture is a flat dictionary; deep object graphs, memory reclamation and lock-free publication require additional contracts.

observations.action: Execute quatro tarefas que cedem a execução enquanto seguram a permissão. Confira no máximo duas dentro da seção e quatro conclusões.
observations.guarantee: A real asyncio semaphore bounds concurrent entry to two and releases its permits after each task.
observations.limit: The semaphore is local to this event loop and does not limit the producer buffer or sum capacity across processes.

observations.action: Submeta quatro tarefas a duas threads reutilizadas, aguarde as respostas e reúna os resultados parciais. Confira a quantidade de executores e o total composto.
observations.guarantee: The executor reuses two workers, forks four computations and joins their four results into one total.
observations.limit: No process pool, distributed worker, work durability or network scatter/gather is claimed.

observations.action: Deixe B ocioso enquanto A tem duas tarefas. Faça B retirar uma tarefa elegível da outra ponta da fila de A e confira uma execução de cada tarefa.
observations.guarantee: An idle worker steals eligible queued work from another worker while task ownership changes exactly once in this schedule.
observations.limit: The deques are manipulated sequentially; a real concurrent deque requires its own atomicity and memory-order guarantees.

observations.action: Adquira duas leituras, tente a escrita, libere as leituras e depois tente ler durante a escrita. Confira as duas formas diferentes de exclusão.
observations.guarantee: Concurrent readers are compatible with each other and incompatible with an exclusive writer in the finite state model.
observations.limit: This is a serialized lock-state schedule, not a thread-safe RWLock implementation or a fairness proof.

observations.action: Execute tentativas ativas enquanto a trava está ocupada e programe sua liberação depois da terceira tentativa. Conte quatro tentativas até a aquisição.
observations.guarantee: The contender repeatedly tests the lock state without blocking, consuming execution steps while the owner is paused.
observations.limit: The model uses serialized test-and-set steps, not a hardware spinlock, CPU benchmark or permission to spin while waiting for HTTP.

observations.action: Faça A e B lerem o mesmo contador, deixe A ganhar o CAS e pause B depois de sua falha. Confira que A ainda consegue concluir outra operação.
observations.guarantee: The CAS retry pattern permits system progress while one contender stalls; this schedule also shows why that is not a per-thread bounded completion guarantee.
observations.limit: The CAS primitive is atomic by model assumption. This is a concrete progress/starvation schedule, not a universal proof for a native-memory implementation.

observations.action: Preencha a fila SPSC de duas posições, tente a terceira inclusão e faça três retiradas. Confira que até a recusa por cheia e o resultado vazio terminam em até quatro passos do modelo.
observations.guarantee: With one producer, one consumer and atomic ordered index publication, each straight-line operation returns success/full/empty in at most four modeled steps without a retry loop.
observations.limit: The bounded-step argument belongs to this SPSC atomic-index model; Python execution time, allocation, native memory ordering and multiple producers are not covered.

observations.action: Solicite dois elementos e depois mais um. Cancele antes do quarto e confira que uma solicitação posterior não reativa a assinatura cancelada.
observations.guarantee: Demand gates delivery and cancellation stops subsequent onNext-style emissions in this local publisher/subscriber contract.
observations.limit: No Reactive Streams library, asynchronous serialization rule or full TCK conformance is claimed.

observations.action: Troque as duas instâncias encerrando todas antes de criar as novas e depois uma por vez. Conte a menor capacidade pronta de cada sequência.
observations.guarantee: Recreate produces a zero-ready interval in this schedule, while a one-at-a-time rolling replacement preserves one ready instance.
observations.limit: Readiness and resource capacity are assumed by the fixture; Kubernetes scheduling and actual service availability are not executed.

observations.action: Mantenha blue e green prontos, altere a rota para green e volte a blue. Confira as versões visíveis e a capacidade antiga que precisou permanecer disponível.
observations.guarantee: Traffic changes between two already-provisioned environments and can return to the previous ready environment.
observations.limit: The route switch does not undo incompatible data written by the new environment; no deployment platform is contacted.

observations.action: Selecione a revisão 2 da fonte declarativa, calcule o plano e aplique-o. Depois introduza drift manual nas réplicas e reconcilie de novo pela mesma revisão.
observations.guarantee: A versioned desired-state source drives the plan and reconciliation instead of allowing manual runtime drift to become the desired source.
observations.limit: The revision store is a local model, not actual Git commits, Terraform state, a cluster operator or deployment proof.

observations.action: Crie a instância 2 com a imagem nova e altere o destino ativo, preservando a instância 1. Compare isso com editar a imagem do recurso existente.
observations.guarantee: The new infrastructure instance is created as a replacement while the prior instance remains unchanged.
observations.limit: Instance identity and images are logical fixtures, without a cloud API, image build or real infrastructure mutation.

observations.action: Faça o cliente usar a fachada, migre somente /orders para a implementação nova e mantenha /positions na antiga. Confira os donos chamados e o contrato observado pelo cliente.
observations.guarantee: An abstraction preserves the caller contract while routing one extracted capability to its new owner, leaving the rest on the legacy path during transition.
observations.limit: The services are logical functions. This does not implement independent deployment, a data migration or a transactional cutover.

observations.action: Extraia as linhas por dono, altere o armazenamento de ordens e confira que a posição não é reescrita pelo acesso direto à mesma tabela.
observations.guarantee: Data is split into stores with explicit capability owners, exposing the need for an integration contract between the formerly shared consumers.
observations.limit: The stores are local maps; schema migrations, foreign-key removal and cross-database reconciliation are not executed.

observations.action: Mude a localização da chave 7 para B no diretório e resolva o dono antes de consultar. Confira que adivinhar A não encontra a posição.
observations.guarantee: An explicit directory maps an entity key to its owning shard, independently of a hash function.
observations.limit: Directory durability, stale entries and live moves are not modeled.

observations.action: Procure a chave 100 nos intervalos 0 até antes de 100 e 100 até antes de 200. Confira que a borda pertence a um único shard.
observations.guarantee: Half-open ranges assign the boundary key to exactly one shard rather than overlapping owners.
observations.limit: Range balancing, splits and hotspot control are separate concerns.

observations.action: Use a região declarada da conta fictícia para escolher a partição e confira onde seu valor foi guardado.
observations.guarantee: A geographic attribute chooses the data owner rather than a key hash.
observations.limit: The geography is hypothetical and is not a claim about a regulatory residency rule.

observations.action: Separe os atributos de contato dos atributos de posição pela mesma chave. Confira quais colunas a consulta de posição precisa ler e reuna a linha somente quando necessário.
observations.guarantee: Vertical partitions divide attributes while preserving the key needed to reconstruct the logical entity.
observations.limit: The example models attribute ownership and does not measure physical page savings or authorization by itself.

observations.action: Acrescente a nova versão em vez de sobrescrever a antiga e resolva a leitura pelo registro mais recente da chave.
observations.guarantee: Updates append records and reads resolve the latest version, exposing the read/compaction work introduced by a log-structured representation.
observations.limit: This is a tiny append-log model, not an LSM tree with SSTables, bloom filters or crash recovery.

observations.action: Agrupe dez substituições do mesmo snapshot de posição antes de confirmar o lote e grave o último valor uma vez. Compare as escritas físicas necessárias.
observations.guarantee: Coalescing repeated overwrites of one snapshot reduces physical writes before the batch acknowledgement.
observations.limit: This applies to replaceable snapshots, not ten independent ledger facts. No per-update durability is promised before the batch flush.
